title: Tridactyl beings of Peru from the Nazca period

tellings.quote: the tridactyl beings in Peru from dated from the Nazca period where there's cave art all over there. One of the the um biioinformatics genetics people found a mutation that matches a human mutation that involves digit differences on the finger.

plain: Three-fingered bodies, called the tridactyl beings, found in Peru and dated to the Nazca period, a region with ancient cave art all around, are said to carry a genetic mutation that matches a human mutation affecting the number of fingers. Michels tells it himself, crediting the find to an unnamed researcher in bioinformatics and genetics and linking it to the Mexican UFO journalist Jaime Maussan, who has promoted the bodies. If true, the bodies would be real beings, not carvings or fakes.
